# Astrivix Corp

> Astrivix Corp is a software engineering and design agency specializing in high-performance web applications, mobile platforms, enterprise cloud architecture, and financial technology solutions.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Services](https://www.astrivix.in/services): Custom software development, full-stack React & Node.js engineering, WebGL/Three.js interactive experiences, and cloud architecture.
- [Portfolio](https://www.astrivix.in/portfolio): High-impact digital products, client case studies, and engineering benchmarks.
- [Financial Consulting](https://www.astrivix.in/financial-consulting): Quantitative financial tech, algorithm design, and technology advisory for growing enterprises.
- [About Us](https://www.astrivix.in/about): Company mission, core principles, and global engineering team background.
- [Careers](https://www.astrivix.in/careers): Open positions for software engineers, UI/UX designers, and product leaders.
- [Contact](https://www.astrivix.in/contact): Direct project inquiries, consultation requests, and project scope estimates.
- [CSR Grant](https://www.astrivix.in/csr): Astrivix Social Responsibility Grant offering 100% free engineering support for non-profits and social enterprises.
